title: Magistral
paper_type_zh: 前沿推理模型技术报告与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 审计 RLVR、程序化验证和推理 trace 冷启动边界的读者
one_line: Magistral reports filtered math/code RL and Medium-to-Small trace transfer, but releases only Small model weights rather than the training corpus, traces, tests or reward logs.
Magistral 具体披露数学/代码筛选、结果奖励、异步 GRPO 和 Medium-to-Small 冷启动，但未发布来源清单、trace、完整测试和审计证据。
why: It shows how to audit a technically detailed frontier RL disclosure without mistaking a model-weight release or benchmark gain for a reusable data release.
inclusion_reason: A detailed frontier RL report that exposes prompt filtering, terminal feedback, optimizer and teacher-to-student lineage while leaving the underlying training records and audit artifacts unreleased.

title: Problem
问题
html: Reasoning reinforcement learning needs prompts that are verifiable, difficult enough to yield reward variation, and suitable for repeated online rollouts. Magistral addresses this with filtered mathematical expressions and contest-code tasks, then combines answer verification with format, length, and language controls. The report is unusually specific about the pipeline, but the prompts, generated trajectories, tests, and per-rollout rewards are not released. The central audit question is therefore what can be reconstructed from the recipe and what remains unavailable as data.
推理强化学习需要结果可验证、难度足以产生奖励差异、并且适合反复在线 rollout 的提示。Magistral 用经过筛选的数学表达式题和竞赛代码题满足这些条件，再用格式、长度和语言约束补充答案验证。报告对流程披露得较细，但没有发布提示、生成轨迹、测试和逐 rollout 奖励。因此，审计重点是区分可从配方还原的部分与仍未成为可用数据工件的部分。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Magistral separates two training lineages. Magistral Medium starts from Mistral Medium 3 Instruct and receives online RL without a reasoning-trace cold start. Magistral Small first learns from correct, later-stage Medium RL traces and additional Medium responses on diverse prompts, then receives online RL. This creates a useful comparison between pure exploration and teacher-trace bootstrapping.

Both lineages couple the data object to its feedback contract. A response must first satisfy a strict reasoning-and-answer format. Math is graded by rule-based normalization, parsers, and SymPy; code is compiled and must pass sampled tests. Soft length penalties and a fastText language-consistency signal shape the response without replacing the terminal correctness check.

Magistral 区分了两条训练血缘。Magistral Medium 从 Mistral Medium 3 Instruct 出发，直接进行在线 RL，没有推理轨迹冷启动。Magistral Small 先学习 Medium 在训练后期产生的正确 RL 轨迹，以及 Medium 在多样化提示上的新增回答，再继续在线 RL。这个设计可用于比较纯在线探索与教师轨迹冷启动。

两条血缘都把数据对象与反馈契约绑定。回答首先必须满足严格的推理区块和答案格式；数学由规则归一化、parser 与 SymPy 判定，代码则编译并运行抽取测试。软长度惩罚与 fastText 语言一致性信号用于塑形，但不替代终局正确性检查。

title: Method
方法
html:
The math pool begins with 699k noisy problems. Completeness and answer-verifiability checks, removal of proof and multipart tasks, and reformulation of multiple-choice items leave 501k. Difficulty filtering first uses sampled Mistral Large 2 solutions, then trains a 24B RL checkpoint as a stronger grader. That grader produces 16 responses per original problem; easy, persistently unsolved, and reference-disagreement cases are removed, leaving 38k items.

The 35k code pool is assembled from contest data gathered from unspecified sources. Problems without solutions or enough tests are removed. Candidate solutions are executed on available tests; low-agreement tests are discarded, tests on which no solution succeeds are revised to the modal output, and missing tests may be generated and checked through the same process. Applicable statements are duplicated to request Python or C++ solutions. During RL, C++ code is compiled with C++20 and a ten-second compile timeout, then run on 20 randomly selected tests shared across the response group, with four seconds and 300 MB per test.

Formatting is a gate: one paired reasoning tag block is required; math must place its final expression in a box and code must use a language-labelled Markdown block. A valid format earns 0.1, and a correct final answer adds 0.9. A soft penalty applies near the completion limit. To reduce language switching, 10% of English problems are translated into French, Spanish, Italian, German, Chinese, and Russian; after LaTeX and code removal, fastText classifies the problem, reasoning, and answer and adds a reward when all three languages match.

The online system keeps trainers, generators, and verifiers active asynchronously. Finished sequences are routed to data-parallel ranks, queue size bounds off-policy lag, and in-flight generations continue with an older key-value cache when weights refresh. Modified GRPO removes KL regularization, normalizes token loss and minibatch advantages, raises the upper clip bound to 0.26-0.28, and removes all-correct or all-wrong groups. For Small, correct later Medium traces and Medium generations on selected OpenThoughts and OpenR1-code prompts are mixed with 10% general instruction data; four epochs of SFT precede RL with 2048 sequences per batch, temperature 1.0, and a 32k non-penalized length limit.

数学池最初包含 699k 道噪声题。完整性与答案可验证性检查、删除证明题和多问问题、以及把选择题改写为陈述题之后，剩下 501k 道。难度筛选先使用 Mistral Large 2 的采样答案，再训练一个 24B RL 检查点作为更强 grader。后者对原始问题各生成 16 个回答，移除过易、持续无法求解及与参考答案存在共识性冲突的题目，最终保留 38k 道。

35k 代码池来自来源未具体披露的竞赛数据。流程删除没有解法或测试不足的问题，在现有测试上运行候选解法，丢弃一致性不足的测试；若所有解法都未通过某个仍具一致性的测试，则用解法输出的众数修订预期结果；缺失测试时还会生成新测试并经过相同检查。适用题面会复制为 Python 或 C++ 要求。RL 阶段以 C++20 编译代码，编译超时为 10 秒；再运行同一回答组共享的 20 个随机抽取测试，每个测试限时 4 秒、内存 300 MB。

格式是硬门控：回答必须包含一对且仅一对推理标签，数学答案需把最终表达式放入方框，代码答案需使用带语言标记的 Markdown 代码块。格式有效获得 0.1，终局正确再增加 0.9；接近长度上限时施加软惩罚。为减少语言切换，10% 的英文问题被翻译为法语、西班牙语、意大利语、德语、中文和俄语；去除 LaTeX 与代码后，fastText 分别识别问题、推理和答案的语言，三者一致时增加奖励。

在线系统让 trainer、generator 与 verifier 异步持续工作。完成的序列被分配到数据并行 rank，队列大小限制离策略滞后；权重刷新时，在途生成仍沿用较旧的键值缓存。改进版 GRPO 移除 KL 正则，对 token 损失和 minibatch advantage 做归一化，把上侧裁剪阈值调到 0.26-0.28，并删除全对或全错的零 advantage 组。Small 使用 Medium 后期正确轨迹，以及 Medium 在筛选后的 OpenThoughts 与 OpenR1 代码提示上生成的回答，并混入 10% 通用指令数据；四个 epoch 的 SFT 之后再做 RL，batch 为 2048 条序列，温度为 1.0，非惩罚长度上限为 32k。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports construction counts, verifier behavior, execution limits, language shaping, the asynchronous rollout path, and the Medium-to-Small lineage. It also reports controlled comparisons: Magistral Medium raises AIME 2024 pass@1 from 26.8 for Mistral Medium 3 to 73.6 and LiveCodeBench v5 from 29.1 to 59.4; for the 24B study, the SFT-plus-RL variant generally exceeds SFT-only and RL-only on the reported math and coding evaluations. These results support the claim that the stated training pipeline changed model behavior, not that its hidden records are complete, licensed, uncontaminated, or intrinsically high quality.

The release evidence is narrower than the training disclosure. Mistral AI publishes Magistral Small 2506 model weights, and the official model card identifies a 24B model with an Apache-2.0 weight license and a Mistral Small 3.1 24B Instruct base. The official announcement describes Magistral Medium as an enterprise variant. Neither the paper, release page, nor model card supplies the RL/SFT dataset, Medium weights, selected traces, verifier tests, reward logs, or record-level lineage.

论文披露了构造数量、verifier 行为、执行限制、语言塑形、异步 rollout 路径以及 Medium 到 Small 的血缘，也给出受控比较：Magistral Medium 的 AIME 2024 pass@1 从 Mistral Medium 3 的 26.8 提升到 73.6，LiveCodeBench v5 从 29.1 提升到 59.4；在 24B 实验中，SFT 加 RL 的方案在多数已报告数学与代码评测上高于仅 SFT 或仅 RL。这些结果支持“所述训练流程改变了模型行为”，但不能证明隐藏记录完整、获授权、无污染或本身高质量。

发布证据的范围比训练披露更窄。Mistral AI 发布了 Magistral Small 2506 权重，官方模型卡说明它是 24B 模型、权重采用 Apache-2.0 许可，并把 Mistral Small 3.1 24B Instruct 标为基础模型。官方发布页则把 Magistral Medium 描述为企业版本。论文、发布页和模型卡都没有提供 RL/SFT 数据集、Medium 权重、入选轨迹、verifier 测试、奖励日志或逐条血缘。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The contribution for reasoning-data curation is the explicit coupling of prompt selection, online generation, executable or symbolic outcome feedback, response-shape rewards, and asynchronous optimization. Difficulty is not treated as a static property: a stronger RL-trained grader revisits the original math pool, and later Medium traces become Small supervision. This makes the report a concrete example of data and policy co-evolution.

The report is also useful because it exposes rejected choices. Partial credit proportional to passed code tests produced denser feedback but slightly worse reported LiveCodeBench performance than binary pass/fail reward, while an entropy-bonus approach was unstable across domain mixtures. These observations constrain the recipe, although they do not make the unreleased corpus reproducible.

对推理数据策展而言，Magistral 的贡献在于明确连接提示筛选、在线生成、可执行或符号化终局反馈、回答形态奖励与异步优化。难度不是静态标签：更强的 RL grader 会重新检查原始数学池，之后 Medium 轨迹又转化为 Small 的监督信号。因此，这份报告展示了数据与策略共同演化的具体流程。

报告还披露了未采用方案。按代码通过测试比例给予部分奖励虽然能产生更稠密的反馈，但其 LiveCodeBench 结果略低于二元通过/失败奖励；entropy bonus 在不同领域混合下也不稳定。这些负结果约束了配方，但仍不足以复现未发布语料。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The report does not publish record identifiers, the sources of the math pool, the specific code-contest sources, final mixture weights, selected OpenThoughts/OpenR1 prompts, Medium traces, general-instruction sources, translation method, rejection logs, reward logs, or the full test suite. Small cold-start size, per-prompt trace counts after selection, full RL group size, total rollout count, Medium sampling temperature, data splits, decontamination, and train-evaluation overlap are unknown. The RL implementation and training infrastructure are described but not released as a reproducible training package.

The verifiers have bounded semantics. Symbolic and parser agreement validates a final expression rather than every reasoning step. Passing 20 sampled tests does not imply correctness on unselected inputs, and revising a test to the modal solution output can encode a shared implementation error. The paper does not calibrate fastText errors or translated-prompt quality. Outcome rewards cannot establish chain-of-thought faithfulness.

Asynchronous generation introduces a documented approximation: weights may change during a completion while its key-value cache remains from an older policy state. Queue bounds and update mechanics are described, but per-sample policy lag and its effect are not audited. Benchmark gains and ablations are model-evaluation evidence only; they cannot substitute for provenance, rights, contamination, or data-quality audits.

报告没有发布样本 ID、数学池来源、具体代码竞赛来源、最终混合比例、入选 OpenThoughts/OpenR1 提示、Medium 轨迹、通用指令来源、翻译方式、淘汰日志、奖励日志或完整测试集。Small 冷启动规模、筛选后每题轨迹数、完整 RL 组大小、rollout 总量、Medium 训练温度、数据切分、去污染和训练—评测重叠均为 unknown。RL 实现与训练基础设施虽有描述，却没有作为可复现训练包发布。

verifier 的语义边界有限。符号和 parser 一致性只验证最终表达式，不验证每个推理步骤；通过 20 个抽取测试不代表在未抽取输入上正确，而用解法输出众数修订测试也可能固化多个实现共有的错误。论文未给出 fastText 误差校准或翻译质量审计。结果奖励也无法证明思维链忠实。

异步生成还引入了论文明确承认的近似：一次生成期间权重可能已经更新，但其键值缓存仍来自较旧策略状态。报告描述了队列约束与更新机制，却没有审计逐样本策略滞后及其影响。基准提升与消融只属于模型评测证据，不能代替来源、权利、污染或数据质量审计。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the frontier-reports data-disclosure ledger track, Magistral is a strong case study in separating four layers: disclosed construction logic, unreleased training records, released Small weights, and benchmark outcomes. A reusable audit derived from this report should request source and license manifests, stable prompt IDs, translated variants, grader scores, reference repairs, selected tests, per-rollout component rewards, rejection reasons, checkpoint hashes, and teacher-student trace links.

The recipe is also useful for designing verifiable reasoning collections. It suggests auditing difficulty with repeated generations, preserving verifier inputs alongside prompts, distinguishing hard format gates from correctness rewards, and recording policy version and staleness for every online trace. Its Medium/Small comparison motivates experiments on pure RL versus teacher-trace cold starts, provided evaluation results are kept separate from claims about data quality.

对于“前沿报告与数据披露账本”轨道，Magistral 是区分四个层次的典型案例：已披露的构造逻辑、未发布的训练记录、已发布的 Small 权重，以及 benchmark 结果。若要把该报告转化为可复用审计，应补充来源与许可清单、稳定提示 ID、翻译变体、grader 分数、参考答案修订、入选测试、逐 rollout 分项奖励、拒绝原因、检查点哈希和教师—学生轨迹链接。

这套配方也能指导可验证推理数据设计：用重复生成审计难度，把 verifier 输入与提示一同保存，区分硬格式门控与正确性奖励，并为每条在线轨迹记录策略版本与滞后程度。Medium/Small 对比还适合设计纯 RL 与教师轨迹冷启动实验，但必须把评测结果和数据质量主张分开。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep the three releases distinct: Magistral Medium is described as an enterprise model, Magistral Small weights are released under Apache-2.0, and no Magistral training dataset is released.
  • Do not confuse 16 math re-grading responses or 20 code tests with the undisclosed GRPO rollout-group size.
  • The reported construction funnel is 699k to 501k to 38k math items, plus 35k code problems; record-level sources remain unknown.
  • Medium uses pure online RL, whereas Small uses Medium-derived SFT followed by RL.
  • Treat benchmark and ablation gains as evidence about trained-model behavior, not proof of prompt, trace, test, or reward quality.

• 区分三类发布状态：Magistral Medium 被描述为企业模型，Magistral Small 权重以 Apache-2.0 发布，而 Magistral 训练数据并未发布。
  • 数学复评的 16 个回答与代码的 20 个测试，都不等于未披露的 GRPO rollout 组大小。
  • 报告中的构造漏斗是数学 699k 到 501k 再到 38k，另有 35k 代码题；逐条来源仍为 unknown。
  • Medium 使用纯在线 RL，Small 则先用 Medium 派生 SFT 冷启动，再继续 RL。
  • benchmark 与消融提升只能说明训练后模型行为，不能证明提示、轨迹、测试或奖励质量。
